Mnemonic: "Bots Only Serve Awesome Data" → NeMo → TensorRT → Triton → RAPIDS
"Bots Only Serve Awesome Data" → NeMo (Build) → TensorRT (Optimize) → Triton (Serve) → RAPIDS (Data)
40% NVIDIA tools — NeMo/Triton/TensorRT/RAPIDS. Know what each does.
Attention formula: softmax(QKᵀ / √d_k) × V — will appear on exam.
TensorRT = any model optimizer. TensorRT-LLM = LLM-specific (KV-cache, batching).
cuDF / Pandas same API — just import cudf not pandas. That's the selling point.
Triton: dynamic batching = #1 production feature. Multi-framework, gRPC/HTTP.
NeMo Guardrails + Colang — expect 2-3 questions. Topical/Safety/Security rails.
BERT = encoder = understanding/classification. GPT = decoder = generation.
RAG for external/live knowledge. Fine-tuning for style/behavior change.
RLHF: Pre-train → SFT → Reward Model → PPO. This is how ChatGPT was built.
~1 min per question. Flag and return. Don't overthink distractor options.
